out.text: Good evening. This is a courtesy notice regarding your heroes' powers.
They've been reviewed. Most of them failed.
My associates will be managing your districts from now on. Please direct all complaints to no one.
And any heroes who object can take it up with me. On the roof.
Have a quiet night. You won't have a choice.
Four districts dark. Half my roster drained. Somebody give me good news.
Good news: the coffee machine survived.
Patch.
Bad news: so did the Redactor.
Can we skip to the part where I'm right? We need more people.
People who aren't scared of him. That's a short list.
Then we make it longer.
Uh. Small thing. Someone's climbing the outside of the Fortress.
Nobody climbs a sixty-storey wall.
Hi! Sorry. Your front door has, like, nine locks.
I'm Volt. I'm a hero. Well... rookie hero. I saw the broadcast, and I want to help.
Oh, I like them.
You're bleeding.
The wall had opinions.
Bastion. Give the rookie a run.
Training roof. Now. Let's see what you've actually got.
Right now? I just climbed sixty floors.
Halo on comms. So you're the rookie everyone keeps talking about.
Halo? THE Halo? Okay. Okay. Be cool. I'm being cool.
You're narrating.
...Yep.
Bastion. I hold this city's line. Tonight, I'm holding yours.
Cool. Great. I'll hold... a different line.
Just hold still and take the gear.
Echo. And before you say anything, I already know how tonight ends.
Do you, though?
...Mostly.
Thorn. I used to be on the other side.
Glad you switched.
Some days, so am I.
Patch. I build the gear. You break the gear.
I'll try to break it less.
You won't. But I appreciate the lie.
Whoa, whoa. Hold up. You're the new kid? They sent the new kid?
I prefer 'rookie'. Sounds more official.
Kid, I've been running furnaces since before you had teeth. You know what happens to things that get too close to the fire?
They... get warm?
They get warm.
Oh, finally. An audience.
I'm here to stop you.
Everyone says that before the first song. Nobody says it after the encore.
Is it a long set?
Darling, it's a residency.
Mind the vines. They bite. Well. They don't bite. They just never let go.
That's somehow worse.
Everything on this roof is slowly becoming mine. The pipes. The rails. You, if you stand still long enough.
Noted. Moving a lot. Got it.
Hi. Over here. No, over here. No, you know what? Pick one. I'll wait.
How about I just hit all of you?
Ooh. Bold. Wrong, but bold.
Picked a bad night to go swimming, rookie.
I didn't really pick it. I kind of just... landed here.
Story of this whole district. Nobody chooses the docks. The docks choose you.
Another one.
Another... what?
Another small, loud hero on my roof. I have carved forty-one names. Yours will be forty-two.
Can you at least spell it right? It's V-O-L-T.
...I will consider it.
Ah. Volt. Rookie. No licence on file. One complaint pending.
Complaint? From who?
Me. You're in my building.
Powers are a privilege, and I'm here to process your revocation.
Yeah, I'm going to have to decline.
That isn't one of the options.
Let's see you move. And no climbing anything.
That dummy's survived forty rookies. Ruin its streak.
Now your Special. Every style's is different. Let's find out what yours does.
Dash. You're untouchable for half a second. Make the half second count.
Slow one coming. When the ring closes, block. Nail the timing and they'll regret it.
Overload's full. Let it rip.
Last ones. Then you're on the clock for real.
You must be the rookie.
Hi. Yes. That's me. Volt. Huge fan. I mean, hi.
Bastion says you asked to join the roster. I didn't vote for you.
Oh. Okay. That's... fair.
Prove me wrong.
So. You're Volt.
That's me! Hi. Nice table.
Don't touch my table.
I wasn't going to—
Workshop's left. Armoury's right. Gate's at the bottom. My table is in the middle. Don't touch it.
Oh, great. The new one.
Hi! I'm Vol—
Volt. I know. I read your file. I read everyone's file.
You read minds. That's not reading a file.
Potato, potahto.
Hi. I'm—
Thorn. And yes. I was one of them.
I wasn't going to ask.
Everyone asks. Mind the ferns.
Patch. Comms, gear, coffee.
In that order?
Depends on the night. The terminal's for upgrades. Shards go in, a better you comes out.
A better me?
A slightly better you. Let's be realistic.
